name: agent-ready
description: Human-tagged. The ONLY state a runner will dispatch. Valid only on stage:ticket.

name: lane:empirical
description: Verified by the gate harness + ledger.

name: stage:wayfinder
description: A question, not a task. Closes when the answer is recorded.

name: stage:spec
description: A published specification. Must link to the wayfinder node it synthesises.

name: stage:ticket
description: Atomic tracer bullet. Must have a stage:spec parent. The only dispatch-eligible stage.

name: needs-human
description: Cost/failure breaker tripped, or red-lane path. Runner will not touch.

name: declined
description: Killed on evidence at the wayfinder stage. Kept, not deleted - a closed option is a result.
